summary: Regression + v3 feature testing on CollerMind. Backend: 52/52 pytest pass covering auth (3 roles: admin/teknisi/kurir), public tariffs/tracking/access/slots, admin CRUD + billings + notifications, cron /api/cron/billing (401 unauth, 200 valid secret, idempotent by run_id), courier RBAC (kurir→admin 403, kurir→tech 403, tech→courier 403, no-auth 401), schedule role guard (delivery→technician rejected 400), E2E order CLM-20260817-8U8U verified: status=active, invoice Rp1.158.000 with Tangerang Selatan rekening, contract signed, 5 monthly billings status=scheduled Bulan ke-2..6 (Rp248.000 each). Frontend: landing navbar clean (Beranda/Sewa AC/Lacak only, no Login/Masuk), footer shows 'Masuk Internal (Admin/Teknisi/Kurir)', tracking page auto-fills kode from localStorage key cm_last_order, admin /admin/billings renders 5 scheduled invoices for the E2E order, admin /admin/notifications lists 8 notifications (4 Email tercatat + 4 WhatsApp simulasi) with data-testid copy-{id} that writes real message to clipboard (toast 'Pesan disalin') and wa-{id} anchors pointing to https://wa.me/6282112223333?text=... with proper 62 prefix and generated invoice/tracking body.
critical_code_review_comments: routes_cron.py cron_billing acks 2xx immediately (good) but background task run_billing_cycle has no try/except around notify_event; a single notify failure would abort the whole cycle silently. Consider per-invoice try/except + error logging.

routes_public.py available_slots does not exclude schedules of non-planned statuses (e.g., in-progress). If a technician is mid-task their slot still counts as taken only when status='planned'. Confirm 'in_progress' schedules should also be considered occupied.
Copy buttons in Notifications.jsx use data-testid=copy-{id} (good), but only icon (no aria-label). Adding aria-label='Salin pesan' would improve a11y and testability by text.
